title: Spend-Based Renewal Loyalty Amount for Small Business Electricity Supply Customers
content:
The renewal loyalty credit of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement grows with what the business has been billed on that agreement.

**Spend-based amount.** The amounts of every line posted on the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date, the handling date itself included, charges, credits and rebill credits alike, are added into the agreement's net billed spend; a net billed spend of 10000 dollars or more earns 1.5 percent of that spend in place of the plan's loyalty credit; a net billed spend of at least 5000 but under 10000 dollars earns the plan's loyalty credit plus 0.5 percent of that spend; a lower net billed spend earns the plan's loyalty credit.

## Net billed spend

Every line on the agreement counts at its signed amount: energy charges, service fees, sales tax and fees add; sign-up, multi-site and loyalty credits and rebill credits subtract. a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date; a line posted on the handling date itself is included.

| Net billed spend | Spend-based amount |
|---|---|
| 10000 USD or more | 1.5 percent of the net billed spend, in place of the plan's loyalty credit |
| 5000 USD to under 10000 USD | the plan's loyalty credit plus 0.5 percent of the net billed spend |
| under 5000 USD | the plan's loyalty credit |

## Hypothetical figures (plan's loyalty credit of 60.00 USD)

| Net billed spend | Working | Spend-based amount |
|---|---|---|
| 12400.00 USD | 1.5 percent of 12400.00 | 186.00 USD |
| 10000.00 USD | 1.5 percent of 10000.00 | 150.00 USD |
| 7200.00 USD | 60.00 plus 0.5 percent of 7200.00 | 96.00 USD |
| 4999.99 USD | the plan's credit | 60.00 USD |
